review_method: direct visual inspection of full-resolution V frames; proposals are not yet imported into any training dataset
class_policy: Only visibly distinct bluish/gray/white smoke is smoke. Orange flame, bright hot ash, vegetation and ground are not smoke.

records.finding: Two existing smoke boxes miss the visible plume and include unrelated ground/vegetation; visible flame is not labeled.
Existing smoke boxes are away from the dominant orange flame; no distinct smoke region can be bounded confidently.
Large smoke box covers ash/ground; tiny visible flame and haze are difficult to separate.
Two smoke boxes fall on vegetation/background while a large flame dominates the image.
Existing smoke box is on left vegetation; large central flame is unlabeled.
Existing smoke region overlaps orange flame; a smaller bluish plume is visible above fire.
Large smoke box covers orange flame and background; existing flame box covers only the lower portion.
Existing smoke box is on right vegetation; central flame and broad diffuse plume are not reliably separated.
